visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with long dark hair stands inside a brightly lit Olive Young retail store in South Korea. She wears a stylish brown wool coat over a white knit top and holds a grey mesh shopping bag filled with various cosmetic products. The background features shelves stocked with facial masks under bright neon signage. (2) The scene shifts to high-resolution close-ups of a woman's face in a studio setting. A pair of hands enters the frame to apply thick, white creamy foam to her forehead and cheeks. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the texture of the foam as it rests on the skin. (3) A series of rapid cuts show the product packaging—a sleek translucent bottle with rose gold hardware labeled 'MENOKIN'. Foam is dispensed onto a hand, showing its dense, bubbly consistency. Graphic overlays display social media 'like' counts and 'before and after' skin texture comparisons. (4) A famous South Korean actress is seen in a promotional clip, wearing a white dress and hugging a giant version of the pink product bottle. The background is a warm, solid yellow. This is followed by the main presenter applying the foam while sitting on an airplane, demonstrating its portability. (5) Detailed split-screen sequences show the presenter applying five different versions of the product (blue, yellow, red, green, purple). She uses her fingertips to massage the foam into her cheeks until it becomes transparent and glossy. She wears various outfits, including a white sweater and a gold necklace. (6) The video concludes with the presenter standing in a well-lit room, gesturing toward five bottles lined up on a surface. She smiles at the camera, her skin appearing highly reflective and hydrated. Text overlays provide promotional details and a call to action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar track with a steady percussion beat. A female narrator speaks in Mandarin Chinese with high pitch and enthusiastic energy, introducing a shopping trip to Korea. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX plays as the narrator explains a 30-second skincare secret. The voice quality is crisp and professional, typical of social media content creators. (3) A soft 'pop' sound effect is heard as foam is visually dispensed. A brief segment of a Korean female voice from a commercial is mixed in, sounding melodic and clear. (4) The BGM continues as a bright, optimistic pop track. The narrator maintains a fast speech rate, detailing the 'bubble capsule technology' with high arousal. Short 'ding' SFX highlight key product features. (5) Multiple rapid-fire sound effects occur as the narrator lists different product colors. The music ducks slightly during the explanation but remains the primary rhythmic driver. (6) The audio concludes with the narrator inviting viewers to join a group buy, her tone becoming warmer and more persuasive. A final 'sparkle' SFX plays before the track cuts to silence.
